question: What Are the Types of Motor Protection Relay Functions?
body_html:
A motor protection relay trips the contactor before damage occurs, using four main functions.

FunctionANSITypical Setting
Thermal overload49100 to 125% FLC, trip class 10, 20 or 30
Short circuit50800 to 1200% FLC, instantaneous
Earth fault51N5 to 20% FLC, 0.1 to 0.5 s
Phase loss46Current unbalance above 15 to 20%

Short circuit pickup sits above the starting peak: Is = 8 to 12 × FLC, so a 20 A motor needs 8 × 20 = 160 A minimum.
